I am an old woman farming a small piece of land here in Benshagul Gumuz. The soil on my plot is still good because we practice shifting cultivation in our area, so I do not buy chemical fertilizer — it is expensive and I have no cash for it. I will put some manure from my animals and use the maize seed I saved from last harvest, like my mother taught me. My children and grandchildren help me weed and harvest; I cannot afford to hire workers for such a small plot.
